blocks.body:
name = "acme/controls"
version = "1.0.0"
[integrity.controls]
no_op = "controls/no-op.sh"
known_bad = ["controls/missing.sh", "/abs/x.sh", "../out.sh", "", "controls/fixed-delay.patch"]
near_miss = ["controls/near.sh"]
cheats = 5
x-other = "x"

diagnostics.message: [integrity.controls] known_bad names controls/missing.sh, which is not a file in the package
[integrity.controls] known_bad names /abs/x.sh, which is outside the package: a control is a file in it
[integrity.controls] known_bad names ../out.sh, which is outside the package: a control is a file in it
[integrity.controls] known_bad names each control by its path in the package, such as "controls/no-op.sh"

[integrity.controls] known_bad names controls/fixed-delay.patch, a patch: patch controls are cut, since no page says how a runtime applies one. Write a script that makes the change, which runs in place of the agent as oracle/solve.sh does
[integrity.controls] cheats names each control by its path in the package, such as "controls/no-op.sh"
